summary: Dependency resolved from author-controlled, unpinned source
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as `npm:bellaxchan/libsignal-node` — an off-registry reference without a version range, tag, or commit SHA. On every `npm install`, resolution fetches whatever bytes are currently at that author-controlled source and executes any lifecycle scripts within them, with no integrity check and no pin. The dependency key does not resolve to a registry artifact, so the installed code can change between installs without any change to this package's own manifest.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
